title: Questions and answers
lead: Short answers to questions often asked about asteroids, comets, impacts and the Minor Planet Center, with links to the sources and to pages on this site that go further. Some answers are written in my own voice. None of them is an official statement of the Minor Planet Center.

topics.mpc: The Minor Planet Center and discoveries

limits: These answers are my own general information, not official statements of the Minor Planet Center (MPC) or of any agency; the linked sources are authoritative.
Requests for help with homework or coursework, and reviews of personal theories, cannot be answered individually.
Questions about submitting observations, designations or MPC services are best sent to the MPC helpdesk, which is staffed for them.
